_info: #64: Rules of the cantons for lump sums from pension savings (simple tax, tax multiplier 100 %). kind=table: tariff «Kapitalauszahlung aus Vorsorge» of the ESTV; kind=income: share `share` of the tax by the income tariff without deductions, rate determined for amount/divisor, bounded by min and max; parts (#288) instead sums the tariff tax on each part of the amount up to upTo times its share. single/married override values per marital status, municipal is the rule of the municipal tax (otherwise the cantonal one applies), cantonMultiplier replaces the cantonal tax multiplier, rebate is a reduction (share of the amount, at most max), approx marks an approximation. text and approx are shown in the tax data file (German); source names the law (#287–#291), only in the report. Derived from the ESTV tax calculator 2026 (Kapitalauszahlung aus Vorsorge, age 65, without children, without denomination); see tools/steuerdaten/README.md.
